findings.hypothesis: A large portion of the created->confirmed gap remains unexplained: known reason clusters (user_total 199417 + artifact_total 42107 = 241524) do not account for the total lost 417569 (difference ~176k). This suggests there are other dominant abandonment drivers not yet captured in the provided reason clusters — possibilities include price sensitivity at higher price bands, consultation/approval friction, or uncoded UX/payment failures. These are correlations; an experiment is required to confirm the true cause.
findings.confirm_via: Use an instrumentation/labeling push or targeted experiments to surface missing reason codes (e.g., prompt a short abandonment survey) and run A/B tests that (a) offer a price/discount treatment to high-price segments and (b) reduce or streamline any consultation steps — measure recovered confirmations vs control.

findings.hypothesis: Losses are concentrated in higher price bands (75k_200k: 90851; gte_200k: 66220), which is consistent with price sensitivity or additional checks/flows required for higher-value orders (e.g., mandated consultations, fraud checks, extra confirmation steps). This is a correlation, not proof of cause.
findings.confirm_via: Run an A/B experiment offering targeted discounts or price messaging to the high price bands (75k_200k and gte_200k) and/or remove/streamline extra verification steps for a randomized subset; measure change in created->confirmed conversion.

findings.hypothesis: The pd_category cut shows distributed entries across categories (e.g., Contraceptions & Hormone 8704, Digital Clinic 3889) but counts are small relative to the ~176k unexplained loss; category-level effects may matter for some niches but do not by themselves explain the bulk of the gap. This is correlative.
findings.confirm_via: If consultation_required or improved labeling shows concentration in few categories, run category-targeted price/inventory or messaging experiments; otherwise focus on funnel-level fixes.

next_question.rationale: We still have ~176k of the created->confirmed loss unallocated (top_gap lost 417569 vs known reasons summing to user_total 199417 + artifact_total 42107 = 241524). Price bands concentrate loss in higher bands (75k_200k: 90851; gte_200k: 66220), and a plausible untested explanation is that many high-value orders require consultation/approval which causes abandonment. consultation_required is the only allowed dimension not yet tried — cut by consultation_required to see whether the unexplained loss and the high-price-band losses concentrate on orders that required consultation (which would point to streamlining/auto-approval or UX fixes) versus being spread across both consultation-required and not-required orders (which would point more to price or platform-level issues).
